source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: In the opposing player's Movement phase, whenever an enemy unit finishes a move and is then within 8" of it, provided this unit is out of Engagement Range of all enemy units, it may make a Normal move, moving no more than D6".

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.condition: this unit not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit
